fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { customerFeedback: "Build a customer feedback form for my online store. Seven days after an order is delivered, email the customer a short form with a 1 to 5 star rating and an optional comment box. If the rating is 2 stars or lower, send our support lead Dana a Slack direct message with the order number, the rating, and the comment. Save every answer to the orders database.", openHouseFeedback: "Make an open house feedback form for my real estate listings. Visitors scan a QR code at the door and answer 3 questions on their phone: what they think of the asking price, the condition of the home and whether they are interested. Count the answers per listing and build a report I can send the seller after each open house.", presentationFeedback: "Create a feedback form for the workshops I run. Attendees rate clarity, pacing and usefulness on a 1 to 5 scale and can leave a comment. Close the form at the end of the day, then show me the average score for each question with the lowest one first, along with the comments for that question.", patientFeedback: "Set up a patient feedback form for our clinics. Two hours after each visit, email the patient a form asking how long they waited and how the staff treated them. If someone reports a wait over 30 minutes, flag the visit to the practice manager for that location with the patient's comment. Keep every answer in our database." };
